title: UX Design Architect - MERN Stack
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start
 **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**
**Primary Responsibilities**
* UI/UX \& Front\-End Design
+ Translate product requirements and user research into wireframes, low/high\-fidelity mockups, and interactive prototypes
+ Build responsive, accessible, and high\-performance user interfaces using modern front\-end frameworks
+ Create, maintain, and scale reusable design systems, component libraries, and style guides
+ Optimize front\-end assets for maximum speed, responsiveness, and cross\-browser/cross\-device compatibility

* Back\-End \& Full Stack Development
+ Design, develop, and maintain scalable server\-side logic and RESTful/GraphQL APIs
+ Manage and optimize database structures for performance and data integrity
+ Integrate third\-party services, APIs, and cloud infrastructure (e.g., AWS, Firebase)
+ Write clean, maintainable, well\-documented code and participate in peer code reviews
+ Test, debug, and troubleshoot applications to fix bugs and enhance performance

* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements


**Required Qualifications**
* Graduate degree or equivalent experience
* 6\+ years of UI/UX Competency and Proficiency in design tools like Figma, Adobe XD, or Sketch, combined with a solid grasp of user\-centered design principles
* Databases: Hands\-on experience with SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB) databases
* Knowledge of Front\-End Stack: Solid command of HTML5, CSS3/Sass, JavaScript (ES6\+), and TypeScript. Experience with modern frameworks like React.js, Next.js, or Vue.js
* DevOps \& Tools: Familiarity with Git/GitHub, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud services (AWS/GCP)
* Back\-End Stack: Proficiency in Node.js and server frameworks (Express.js, NestJS)
* Soft Skills: Proven excellent problem\-solving abilities, communication skills, and openness to iterative feedback


*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone\-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income\-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*
 \#Nic

 • Create clear design specifications and documentation for development teams and collaborate closely with developers throughout implementation.
 



 • Build and maintain scalable design systems and component libraries for web and mobile.

 • Create professional graphic design assets when required, including flyers, website graphics, banners, product visuals, and presentation materials.

 • 6 \+ years of professional UI/UX or Product Design experience, or an exceptional portfolio demonstrating equivalent capability.
 



 • Strong portfolio demonstrating high\-quality UI/UX across web and mobile products.
 



 • Advanced proficiency in Figma and modern design and prototyping tools.
 



 • Strong understanding of UX principles, interaction design, information architecture, responsive design, usability, and accessibility.
 



 • Excellent visual design skills with a strong sense of colour and colour combinations, typography, spacing, hierarchy, layout, and visual consistency.
 



 • Strong product and Business Analysis skills with the ability to turn complex or ambiguous ideas into structured, practical design solutions.
 



 • Strong analytical, research, and problem\-solving abilities.
 



 • A self\-starter with a high level of ownership, creativity, curiosity, and initiative. You should be comfortable thinking independently and moving work forward without requiring detailed direction at every step.
 



 • Excellent English communication and writing skills.
 



 • Experience designing complex, multi\-role platforms involving different users, dashboards, permissions, and workflows.
 



 • Experience working closely with developers and understanding front\-end implementation constraints.
 



 • Familiarity with usability testing and UI/UX quality assurance.
 



 • Strong graphic design skills, including the ability to create professional flyers and digital marketing assets.
 



 • Awareness of emerging AI technologies and AI\-driven user experiences.
 



 • Experience in EdTech, B2B SaaS, SaaS, or enterprise platforms is preferred.

 • Opportunity to help shape a large\-scale product serving the global education ecosystem.
 



 • Meaningful involvement in product and UX direction, not just screen design.

 inderpreet@intoto.ca

description:
Location: Noida, India
   

  

 Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
   

  

 Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber \& Digital sectors. * Ability to design complex user flows and systems

**Prototyping \& Technology**

* Strong collaboration skills with cross\-functional teams (design, engineering, product)

 **Product Design Intern @ Neary 🫟** 




  





 Good design isn't the file you open in Figma first. It's the question you ask before you open Figma at all.
 



  





 Neary is a people\-first app for real\-world connection: no follower counts, no algorithm deciding who deserves your attention. Just proximity, honesty, and every screen we ship having to earn its place. We're looking for a designer who cares as much about
 *why* 
 as
 *what* 
 .
 



  





 This one's for a college student/part\-time consultant, who's hungry to design something real instead of another case study for a portfolio nobody asked for.
 



  





  





**👀 What you'll actually do** 



* Turn fuzzy "what if we..." ideas into flows that actually make sense
* Design in Figma daily, components, auto layout, prototypes people can actually click through
* Build and maintain our design system, themes, tokens, components that don't fall apart the third time someone reuses them
* Iterate fast. Ship a version, get roasted in feedback, fix it properly (not just patch it), move on
* Ask "wait, what problem are we solving here?" before you ask "what should this look like?"
* Keep your files clean. Future\-you, and the engineer picking it up, will thank you
* Sit with engineering and watch your design become a real, tappable thing
* Say "I don't think this is right" out loud, even to us. Especially to us.

* Real comfort in Figma, and genuine excitement to get better at it
* An eye for design systems and theming, consistency isn't boring, it's the whole game
* Speed without sloppiness: you iterate quickly and still land on the right fix, not just
 *a* 
 fix
* Product thinking: you notice
 *why* 
 an app feels good to use, not just how it looks
* The instinct to ask good questions before jumping to solutions
* Actual enthusiasm. We can teach skills. We can't teach whether you care.
* A team\-player streak, you take feedback without flinching, and give it kindly too
* Currently in college, third year preferred 🎓

* Mode: Remote

* Internship Certificate \+ Letter of Recommendation
* Real screens, shipped to real users, not filed away in a design system nobody opens
* Direct mentorship, not a "watch this Loom later" kind
* A portfolio piece with an actual story: the problem, the questions you asked, the thing you shipped

 You get a small thrill from a clean file and a cleaner flow. You'd rather ask an awkward question in a meeting than guess quietly and be wrong later. You move fast, fix things right, and care about your team as much as your craft.

 As a Product Engineer with 10 years of experience, you sit at the intersection of product thinking and engineering execution. You own the full arc of a feature — from understanding the problem, to building a working prototype, shipping and delivering its outcome. You bring both the business knowledge of what to build and the technical depth to ensure it is built well, with a personal stake in quality at every stage
   

  

**What You Will Be Responsible For**
 Product Value Delivery
   

  

* Translate business goals and user needs into product opportunities with clear value hypotheses.
* Prototype solutions early and often — directly, to validate ideas before committing to full build
* Define scope collaboratively with stakeholders, keeping scope anchored to user value rather than feature count.
* Track and communicate the impact of what ships; deliver outcome, not just the output.


 Engineering Quality
   

  

* Write and review technical requirements and acceptance criteria that leave no ambiguity at implementation time.
* Assess feasibility early and frame build\-vs\-integrate trade\-offs in terms of delivery impact, risk, and value — enabling informed decisions across product and engineering.
* Be the last line of defense on quality: review and test deliverables against requirements, run validation, and hold the bar.
* Identify and highlight technical debt and systemic risks before they become delivery blockers.
* Keep system documentation live and accurate — treated as a product asset, not an afterthought.


 AI\-Enabled Development
   

  

* Use AI tools (Copilot, Claude, and others) fluently as part of your everyday working routines.
* Critically evaluate AI\-generated artifacts — verify correctness and architectural fit before accepting.
* Guide your team on responsible AI usage: when to trust it, when to override it, and how to review it carefully
* Identify where AI can accelerate prototyping cycles and reduce low\-value work in the team.


 Team Agile Practices
   

  

* Maintain a healthy, prioritized product backlog — each item sized, scoped, and ready for the team.
* Work closely with software engineers during implementation — unblock, review, and course\-correct in real time
* Be the connective tissue between stakeholders and the delivery team: clear in both directions.

* Governance \& Standards: Establish and enforce standards for code quality, automated testing (Jest, Playwright), accessibility, and security. Introduce formal processes like Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) to document technical choices.

**What You Bring (Must\-Have Qualifications)**

* Frontend Architecture: Proven experience designing and delivering component\-driven, micro\-frontend, or platform\-based frontend architectures. Experience with single\-spa or similar orchestration frameworks is preferred.
* SaaS \& Multi\-Tenant Architecture: Strong understanding of designing secure enterprise SaaS applications, including authentication, authorization, Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA), and multi\-tenant architectures.
* State, Data \& API Management: Strong expertise in client\-side state management, data\-fetching strategies, and type\-safe client\-server API contracts across distributed UI modules.

* Communication: Exceptional interpersonal skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to non\-technical stakeholders, Product Managers, and Backend Architects.
* Platform Engineering Experience: Experience with monorepos, internal package publishing, design systems, Storybook, and reusable developer tooling.
* Frontend Governance: Ability to define and drive standards for theming, accessibility, linting, formatting, dependency management, and architectural consistency across multiple teams.
* AI\-Assisted Development: Hands\-on familiarity with AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, or similar tools, with the ability to define practical usage patterns for engineering teams.


**Good To Have (Preferred Skills)**
* Frontend Observability: Experience instrumenting client\-side RUM, error\-tracking, and distributed tracing (e.g., OpenTelemetry) to support platform reliability metrics.
* Backend for frontend / Lightweight Service Ownership: Familiarity with lightweight Node.js, Express, or equivalent services that support frontend configuration, aggregation, or API composition.
* Legacy Framework Migration: Experience modernizing applications that carry legacy CSS frameworks (e.g., Bootstrap) alongside a component\-driven design system.
* Data Visualization Architecture: Working knowledge of charting libraries (e.g., D3\.js) for teams with heavy analytics or dashboard requirements.
* Package \& Release Governance: Experience with semantic versioning, deprecation policies, private package registries, and consumer migration strategies.
